title: Young adults in the U.S. are increasingly wary of AI, concerned it will take jobs
summary_en: About half of Americans say they’re more concerned than excited about AI, and young adults’ concern is rising.
title_cn: Young adults in the U.S. are increasingly wary of AI, concerned it will take jobs

title: Refugee admissions to the U.S. are dropping sharply in Trump’s second term
summary_en: U.S. refugee admissions have dropped sharply in Trump’s second term, with just over 10,000 so far in fiscal 2026, down from about 38,000 in fiscal 2025.
title_cn: Refugee admissions to the U.S. are dropping sharply in Trump’s second term
